We were really busy this day. Mára Tryner was preparing to coach  a small group of enthusiasts. Lukáš Valný and Matouš were ready for the advanced camp, and Martin and Vlasta were doing the rounds of exhibitions. 

Changes in the weather meant everything got a bit complicated. Mára had to move his lesson. The camp was cancelled (riders could sign up for the next weekend), and the first of the two exhibitions was really for the brave. 

The Brdy forests are a truly beautiful place, and the event itself was on a beautiful large clearing in the middle. Unfortunately the weather wasn't kind to the organisers – it rained practically non-stop and a cold wind blew. Luckily some spectators weren't put off, and the organiser provided enough fire pits to warm up and roast sausages. We tried to run our workshop in the breaks between rain showers, and finally in the late afternoon we got a 15-minute break when even the sun peeked out. We rode a quick exhibition, which ended not only with applause from the spectators but also with a proper downpour. 

After quickly packing up the obstacles we headed for Prague-Modřany, where a crowd at a company party was waiting for us. Luckily without rain by then, we could fully show what we can do and entertain the diverse audience of this multicultural company.
